claim_scope: The already installed original raw dependent face on the named continuous family is read from its sealed runtime registry. Actual environment-function uniformity is generated for that family; paid steps keep the native clock and actual births increment it. Full native recovery precedes the actual syntax cursor/occurrence/prefix restriction. At the generated bounded birth ordinal, existing native budget/localSettlement/completed_value laws and the original independent Reached/Exhausted recognizer consume the real raw actor result. This is a mathematical semantic-consumer checkpoint for an existing installed face.
certified_machine_facts: The three frozen production files, direct 21-mouth gate and both provenance gates independently pass fresh trust0/warningAsError.
Generic Environment is universe-polymorphic with 200 actual local imports and no domain dependency; At is a property of the actual environment function over original occurrences.

Initial uniformity comes from dynamicFeed.environment being the actual computed updatedEnvironment. Both nextEnvironmentReadAt and legacy decoder branches are constant functions after birth; fallback uses the previously proved At property. Paid mathNext preserves the original function.
frames_env derives uniformity on the exact named Shared.frames family; actual_epoch_env follows from that proof, not a premise about arbitrary frames.

actorClock uses only actual frame.action, remains fixed on paid and increments on actual settlement. Existing Births actual_action/index growth and monotonicity generate strict clock growth at cofinal birth points.
The direct negative control rejects any witnessed nonuniform environment; actual paid-after-birth, paid-keep and birth-plus-one controls prevent one-macro-tick/one-actor-action conflation.

rawCoimage uses Context.readEnv with existing Observation.rawSource and the named sealed runtime state. Observation.raw_actual recovers its existing registry coordinate and reads the inherited installed raw restriction.
birth_raw identifies that installed registration raw with the old actual active environment. The new decoder active environment is a separate existing CP74 result.

raw_full applies existing complete inverse to recover the exact fixed-root native point before raw_material projects to the syntax-derived cursor; raw_prefix retains the original occurrence and full ordered prefix within its stated pulse bound.
raw_completed uses the generated birth-clock lower bound, original native remaining budget, source-derived localSettlement and completed_value. No completed result enters the primitive raw reader.
raw_original_disposition then invokes the existing original two-branch recognizer, preserving both genuine Reached/settlement and Exhausted/obstruction outputs.

The direct gate consumes the recovered original native point whole/next factorization and the same named macro Births actual_next/actual_compiles. No new installed face or physical strict payment is generated.
